app.title: ANT Console
session.loadError: The server could not be reached to read your sign-in status. Retry; your existing session has not been signed out.
session.logoutError: Sign-out did not finish; the session may still be active. Check your connection and retry.
state.empty.backendPending: This capability is not connected yet — this version provides the interface skeleton only, and nothing is saved.
page.providers.title: Providers
config.description: Review the active configuration, or create a draft, validate it, and explicitly activate a new revision. Configuration revisions are stored by the server; secrets use credential references only.
config.signInRequired: Sign in to view configuration for your namespace.
config.empty.title: No active configuration yet
config.empty.description: Create a draft to add accounts, resources, and pools. Empty drafts can be saved, but the server will not use an unvalidated draft for execution.
config.active.title: Active configuration
config.readOnly: This account has read access only and cannot create, save, or activate configuration.
config.localtestNotice: This server is using a local test catalogue. Its provider data is not a real service.
config.draft.bookmarkHint: This address contains the draft ID. Bookmark it to continue later.
config.draft.unavailable: This draft could not be read. It remains on the server; check the link or connection and retry.
config.editor.label: Configuration document
config.editor.help: This is the full configuration draft. Accounts, connections, resources, evidence, routes, and pools must reference each other correctly; never put a cleartext secret in configuration.
config.editor.description: Edit as JSON. Saving keeps an invalid draft available for repair; only server validation allows activation.
config.editor.invalidJson: The configuration is not a valid JSON object. Fix the syntax; the server draft still contains its last saved version.
config.account.title: Add a provider account
config.account.help: Fields come from the provider catalogue registered by the server. The account is added to this draft; save and validate before activation.
config.account.name: Account display name
config.account.idHelp: Use a stable ID for this configuration (1–64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons, or hyphens). The server catalogue must still verify account and capacity facts.
config.account.invalidId: The account ID must be unique, 1–64 characters, and use only letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons, or hyphens.
config.account.selectFixtureScope: Choose an unused local test account scope.
config.account.invalidField: Field {field} must be a valid number.
config.binding.title: Add a service connection
config.binding.help: Credentials are encrypted through a separate endpoint; bindings store only the credential reference and revision. This adds the connection to the draft and saves it automatically.
config.binding.selectAccount: Select an account for the current provider.
config.binding.invalidEndpoint: Use a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without a username, password, query, or fragment; the provider must support the selected domain.
config.binding.rotateHelp: The new credential is encrypted as an immutable revision and updates the selected draft connection. The active configuration keeps using its existing revision until the new draft is activated.
config.binding.selectBinding: Select a connection owned by an account for this provider.
config.binding.rotated: Credential encrypted and stored ({mask}); the draft connection is updated and takes effect after validation and activation.
config.balance.title: Check account balance
config.balance.help: ANT sends one read-only balance request with the selected saved credential. No chat content is sent.
config.balance.selectFirst: Select a connection with a saved credential. Add a connection first if none is listed.
config.balance.available: The provider reports the account is available
config.balance.unavailable: The provider reports the account is currently unavailable
config.balance.caveat: This is the balance reported at query time, not a reservation or spending guarantee. It does not confirm account identity or spending after the query.
config.balance.error.session: Your sign-in expired. Sign in and retry; the saved connection and earlier observation remain.
config.balance.error.permission: This account cannot check balances. The connection and earlier observation are unchanged.
config.balance.error.notFound: No saved observation exists at this address yet. Run the check again; the connection is unchanged.
config.balance.error.stale: This credential revision is no longer current. Select the latest saved connection and retry; the draft and earlier observation remain.
config.balance.error.provider: The provider did not return usable balance data. Check the credential or retry later; the connection and earlier observation remain.
config.balance.error.busy: Balance checks are temporarily busy. Retry later; this request was not sent and your saved connection and observation remain.
config.balance.error.unavailable: The balance check could not be confirmed. Check the connection and retry with the same command; the saved connection and earlier observation remain.
config.balance.error.cancelled: Waiting stopped. If the server saved a result, you can read it again; the connection is unchanged.
config.resource.title: Add resources from verified facts
config.resource.help: Choose local test facts that match the connection capability profile. Capacity, dimensions, and windows come directly from the server catalogue. These are test values, not real account balances.
config.resource.selectFacts: Choose one fact for every required capability dimension.
config.offer.title: Create an offer and add it to a pool
config.offer.help: The offer bundles the resources required by the registered capability profile, then joins a new pool in this namespace. Priority starts at 10; validate and activate the draft using the draft actions below.
config.offer.incompleteResources: This connection is missing resources required by its capability profile. Add each required dimension first.
config.pool.name: Resource pool name
resources.empty.title: No active resources yet
resources.empty.help: Resources appear from the active configuration. On the provider page, select catalogue facts to build resources with a verified bound and source, then validate and activate the draft.
resources.capacity.note: Configured bounds come from the active configuration. Live balances and occupancy are shown by pool and usage window. Unknown balances are never treated as zero; test data is marked.
resources.balance.error: Live balances are temporarily unavailable. The active configuration is still shown. Check access or try again later.
resources.observe.title: Record balance observation
resources.observe.help: Check the current balance in the provider's billing or quota page, then record it here. ANT does not contact the provider from this form; the source reference is saved with the observation.
resources.observe.quantityHelp: Enter a non-negative integer in the smallest unit, without separators or decimals.
resources.observe.invalidSource: Enter a source reference that is not blank.
resources.observe.invalidQuantity: The balance must be a canonical non-negative integer within the int64 range.
resources.observe.invalidDates: The reading time cannot be in the future; expiry must be after both the reading time and now.
resources.observe.observedAt: When the provider data was read
resources.observe.baselineHelp: The window and ledger watermarks above are bound to this request. If either changes, the server rejects the stale reading instead of replacing newer balance data.
resources.observe.disabledHelp: Enter the source reference, balance, and validity period to save.
resources.observe.saved: Observation saved; resource balance is updating. Usage recorded after the reading is deducted conservatively.
resources.observe.stale: The ledger watermark changed while this was being read. The observation was not applied. Refresh resources and check the provider balance again.
resources.observe.sourceUnavailable: The source is unavailable, so the observation was not applied. Check the source reference and retry.
resources.observe.ambiguous: Balance data differs across pools. Refresh the page before recording an observation.
resources.observe.error.notFound: The resource or usage window changed; the observation was not saved. Refresh and check again.
resources.observe.error.conflict: This request conflicts with a previously saved action. Refresh and check the current balance.
resources.observe.error.request: The observation result is unconfirmed. Your entries remain; retrying unchanged reuses the same request ID.
pools.empty.title: No active resource pools yet
pools.empty.help: On provider setup, bundle the complete capability resources into an offer and add it to a namespace pool. It appears here after validation and activation.
pools.live: Live resources and availability come from the server projection. Unknown balances are never shown as zero.
pools.members.empty: This pool has no offers yet.
pools.order.conflict: The active configuration changed. The order was not saved; refresh and reorder from the latest revision.
operations.empty.title: No operation records in this namespace
operations.empty.help: Operation history comes from persisted server records.
operations.submit.title: Submit a text request
operations.submit.localtestNotice: The available adapter is a local simulator. It contacts no real provider; its reply and usage are synthetic.
operations.submit.noPool: No enabled pool includes the basic text capability.
operations.submit.meteredHelp: This local fixture records a synthetic 1 cent usage amount. Submission stays disabled until you opt in.
operations.submit.retrySafe: The request result is unconfirmed. Retry without changing the form to reuse its operation ID, so the server can return the original operation state safely.
operations.list.help: This list comes from persisted server records. Running operations refresh their projection every five seconds.
operations.list.polling: Running details follow the persisted event stream and refresh from the server projection on reconnect.
operations.detail.title: Operation details
operations.decisions.title: Recorded selection decisions
operations.decisions.empty: No decision trace is available for this operation.
operations.decisions.truncated: The saved trace was shortened to fit the record size limit.
operations.error.notFound: No operation record with this ID exists in the current namespace.
operations.cancel.title: Cancel operation
operations.cancel.help: Send a cancellation intent. “Recorded” means the server saved it; if the provider already received the request, the final state still waits for execution evidence.
operations.cancel.persisted: The server recorded the cancellation intent and is waiting for an operation result.
operations.cancel.status.recorded: Cancellation intent recorded. The operation stays running until the server persists its final result.
operations.cancel.status.alreadyTerminal: The operation has ended; its final result was not changed.
operations.cancel.status.notFound: This operation was not found. Refresh its details before trying again.
operations.cancel.conflict: This command ID was already used for a different request. Refresh the details and try again.
operations.cancel.error: Cancellation was not confirmed. Refresh the operation; if it is still running, you can request cancellation again.
operations.reconcile.title: Reconcile execution
operations.reconcile.help: Enter the reviewed result and actual usage from provider records. The reconciliation is appended without overwriting the original unknown result; uncertain occupancy stays held when the outcome remains unknown.
operations.reconcile.evidenceHelp: Enter one or more evidence references, separated by commas or new lines.
operations.reconcile.saved: The reconciliation was appended to the ledger; the original result remains unchanged.
operations.reconcile.conflict: This attempt changed or the command ID was already used. Refresh the details and review again.
operations.reconcile.error: The reconciliation was not confirmed. Refresh the details and check for a saved record before retrying.
operations.result.title: Final result
operations.result.summary.UnknownOutcome: The request may have reached the provider, but the final outcome is unconfirmed. Check the provider record before deciding whether to retry.
operations.result.summary.Cancelled: The server confirmed cancellation and saved the final outcome.
operations.result.summary.AffinityUnavai: The selected account or connection is unavailable. Review the attempts below before changing the selection.
operations.result.summary.DeadlineExceed: The request exceeded its time limit. Review the attempts and usage before deciding what to do next.
operations.result.summary.AttemptsExhaus: This operation reached its allowed attempt limit. Review its record before creating another operation.
operations.result.summary.ExecutionInter: The server stopped the operation before dispatch; no request was sent to the provider.
operations.result.summary.AdmissionBlock: The active configuration or available resources do not allow this request. Review the reasons and usage before taking action.
operations.result.summary.DomainFailure: The provider reported that the request could not be completed. Review the attempt and account status.
operations.result.summary.unknown: The operation result was saved. Review the reasons and usage below before taking another action.
operations.reason.unknown: The system recorded an additional decision detail. Review the operation history before deciding whether to retry.
operations.reason.hook.candidate_rejecte: A configured execution check rejected this candidate before any reservation or provider request.
operations.reason.accounting.actual_out_: Reported usage exceeded the supported range. The original value was retained and needs review.
operations.reason.execution_recovery.dis: The request may have been sent, but the provider outcome is unconfirmed. Do not retry until its record has been checked.
operations.reason.execution_recovery.own: The server stopped before dispatch; the record confirms no external request was sent.
operations.reason.cancellation.cancel_re: Cancellation intent was recorded. The final outcome still depends on confirmed provider and server facts.
operations.reason.capacity.capacity_exha: There is not enough available capacity. Review the resource and its recovery time, or update a verified configuration.
operations.reason.budget.attempts_spent: This operation used its allowed attempts.
operations.reason.admission.preparation_: The current resources or policy do not allow this request to start. Review their status and limits.
operations.reason.admission.invalid_quan: The resource quantity or unit is invalid. Correct the resource configuration and validate it again.
operations.reason.admission.scoped_hold: This resource is restricted while its usage is reviewed. It will not be used for new requests until then.
operations.reason.concurrency.preparatio: Configuration or resource state changed during preparation. Refresh and review the request again.
operations.reason.plan.preparation_inval: The execution plan does not match the active configuration. Review and validate the configuration again.
operations.reason.spend_policy.allowMete: This request requires usage-based billing, which the current spending setting does not allow.
operations.reason.affinity.affinity_unsp: The required account or connection was not specified. Complete the selection and submit again.
operations.reason.affinity.affinity_bind: The selected connection does not match the required connection. Update the selection and submit again.
operations.reason.affinity.affinity_acco: The required account could not be verified. Refresh the configuration and submit again.
The selected connection does not belong to the required account. Update the selection and submit again.
operations.reason.eligibility.member_dis: This service route is disabled in the pool.
operations.reason.overrun.actual_exceede: Actual usage exceeded the reserved limit. The system recorded it and restricted the affected resource.
operations.reason.settlement.reliable_un: The request was confirmed unsent, so its reservation was released.
operations.reason.settlement.conservativ: Actual usage could not be confirmed, so the system recorded a conservative limit.
operations.reason.attribution.window_att: The usage period could not be confirmed. The affected resource was isolated to prevent reuse.
operations.reason.domain.known_failure: The provider confirmed the request failed. Review the attempt and account status.
operations.reason.domain.recipient_suppr: This recipient is suppressed. Other providers will not be tried until the suppression is cleared.
operations.action.review_usage: Check provider usage and complete the account review before submitting a new operation.
operations.action.check_provider_account: Check provider account status and usage. Confirm whether the request was processed before taking the next step.
operations.action.unknown: Review the operation history and resource usage before deciding what to do next.
operations.result.pending: This operation is still running and has no committed result yet. The page refreshes its status periodically; closing the browser does not change the server operation.
operations.outputBody.title: Saved response
operations.outputBody.empty: No response chunks have been committed yet.
operations.attempts.title: Execution attempts
operations.reconciliations.title: Follow-up reconciliation
operations.detail.polling: If the stream disconnects or the browser lacks EventSource, the page falls back to periodic reads. Output bodies use a separately authorized endpoint and are never reconstructed from events or logs.
operations.detail.stream.reconnecting: Live connection interrupted; reconnecting and checking periodically meanwhile.
operations.detail.stream.closed: The operation ended; showing its persisted result.
operations.detail.stream.unavailable: This browser lacks live events; checking periodically instead.
config.validation.localHelp: These hints come from browser-side structure and reference checks. The server decides whether activation is allowed.
config.validation.serverHelp: The draft is preserved. Fix these paths and validate again; the active revision has not changed.
config.validation.issue: Check this field and its references.
config.validation.passed: Server validation passed. Activation will check the latest version and references again.
config.closeConfirm.title: You have unsaved changes
config.closeConfirm.body: Save before closing, or discard your latest edits. Continuing to edit keeps the current content.
config.error.conflict: Configuration changed in another operation. Your draft is preserved; refresh the active revision and create a draft from the latest version.
config.error.permission: This account does not have configuration access. Nothing was changed on the server.
config.error.session: The sign-in session expired. Sign in again; unconfirmed edits remain in this editor.
config.error.request: The request did not finish. Check the server connection and retry; unconfirmed edits remain in this editor.
config.error.notExecutable: The configuration is not executable yet. The draft and active revision are preserved; review the field issues, complete the configuration, and validate again.
config.error.invalid: The server rejected this configuration. Fix the fields and save again; the active revision has not changed.
config.error.rateLimited: The server is temporarily busy and your draft is preserved. Retry later; this request is not sent again automatically.
config.activation.confirmBody: The revision passed server validation. New requests in namespace {namespace} will use it; requests already running keep the configuration they selected.
config.activation.confirmedAfterDisconne: The connection dropped, so the server was checked: this draft is active and the current revision has been refreshed.
page.resources.title: Resources
page.pools.title: Pools
page.operations.title: Operations
page.login.title: Sign in
page.login.help: Enter the administrator's one-time bootstrap token to start a browser session. It is sent only to this server and is not written to browser storage.
page.login.invalidToken: The token is invalid, already used, or expired. Obtain a fresh one-time bootstrap token from the server; this input was not saved.
page.login.failed: The sign-in request did not finish. Check the server connection and retry; your input remains in this form.
notFound.title: Page not found
operations.admin.title: Resource adjustments and holds
operations.admin.adjustmentHelp: Negative values reverse the selected recorded charge, up to its remaining reversible amount. Positive values add usage and may create an over-capacity hold.
operations.admin.holdBlocked: Open occupancy still matches this hold. Resolve or reconcile that occupancy before clearing it.
operations.admin.conflict: The resource changed or this command ID was already used. Refresh the details and review before retrying.
operations.admin.deltaTooLarge: This exceeds the remaining reversible amount ({amount}).
resourceDraft.description: Save subscription accounts and resource rules first. Connect and consume them later.
resourceDraft.declaration: These are declared resource rules, not available balances. Credentials are optional and saving sends no provider request. Provider rules and capacity sources must be verified before use.
resourceDraft.accountHelp: Use the account name for your subscription or plan. You can configure a future provider and add its resources now.
resourceDraft.providerHelp: Choose a registered type or enter a future provider ID. Unregistered types remain drafts.
resourceDraft.accountInvalid: Enter a name and valid, unique account ID and provider ID. IDs allow letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon and hyphen, up to 64 characters. Your input is preserved.
resourceDraft.accountRequired: Add a subscription account before configuring its resources. A connection is optional.
resourceDraft.empty: No resources in this draft. Add quotas, entitlement buckets or concurrency limits.
resourceDraft.quantityHelp: Enter an integer from 0 to 9223372036854775807. For usd_cents, 100 means USD 1. This does not create an available balance.
resourceDraft.anchorHelp: Leave empty for calendar periods, or enter an ISO timestamp with time zone for the subscription renewal anchor.
resourceDraft.expiryHelp: Enter an ISO timestamp with time zone, e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00+08:00. Leave empty if no expiry is declared.
resourceDraft.invalid: The rule was not applied. Check the owner, unique resource ID, metric and unit, integer capacity, precision, valid time zone and dates with time zone. Your input is preserved.
resourceDraft.saved: Resource configuration saved as draft version {version}. Reopen it using this URL.
resourceDraft.conflict: The stored draft version changed. Your local edits are preserved. Review them, then explicitly reload the stored version and reapply your edits.
resourceDraft.referenced: Referenced by {references}. Repair references in provider configuration before editing or removing this resource.
resourceDraft.removeHelp: Remove from this draft. The stored draft changes only after you save.
resourceDraft.issueHelp: Missing evidence and unsupported rules do not prevent draft saving, but block validation and activation. Finish configuring resources first.
resourceDraft.shape: This draft needs its document structure repaired. Open provider configuration to edit it. Saved data is preserved.
resourceDraft.leaveHelp: There are unsaved changes. Apply the open form to the draft first, or explicitly discard changes before leaving.
resourceDraft.reloadHelp: Reloading replaces local edits with the stored version. Cancel to keep your current input.
resourceDraft.applyFirst: Apply the open rule to the draft, or cancel the form, before saving.
resourceDraft.locked: This draft is activated or archived. Create a new draft from the resource page to make changes. The saved version is preserved.
supply.subtitle: Configure the plans and packages your accounts own.
supply.accountHelp: Reuse the same account for packages that share billing or quotas. Credentials can be connected later.
supply.packagePlaceholder: Use the name shown by your provider
supply.priceBasis: Price basis, for example per million tokens
supply.allowancesHelp: Enter the quantities and rules from your plan. These are configured allowances, not remaining balances.
supply.quantityPlaceholder: Enter the full quantity, for example 3000000
supply.sharedHelp: These account limits apply automatically to every package on this account. Their quantities are shared, not copied.
supply.saved: Configuration saved and read back from the server.
supply.invalid.0: Name the account and choose a provider. Your input is kept.
supply.invalid.1: Check the package name, dates, time zone and price. Your input is kept.
supply.invalid.2: Check each resource quantity and reset rule. Your input is kept. Pay-as-you-go requires a spending cap.
supply.conflict: Someone changed this inventory. Review the latest saved version before saving again; your fields are kept.
supply.reviewLatest: Latest inventory loaded. Compare its saved rules with your retained fields before saving.
supply.serverInvalid: These rules cannot be saved together. Check the limits, dates and references; your input is kept.
supply.requestError: Could not read or save configuration. Retry when the server is available; your input is kept.
supply.readbackError: The save succeeded, but readback failed. Retry to read the saved result; the same command will not create another copy.
supply.empty: No plans or resource packages yet
supply.emptyHelp: Add the plan you already own, with its allowances, reset rules and expiry. No API key is needed for this step.
supply.configuredNote: Saved configuration · version {version}. Remaining balances and execution will be connected in the next phase.
supply.archiveHelp: Archive {name} and remove it from configured pools. Its rules remain saved and can be restored. This does not cancel the provider subscription.
supply.leaveHelp: This setup has not been saved. Keep editing or discard it to leave.
supply.legacyPreserved: Your earlier technical draft is preserved. It has not been converted into a plan or package.
supply.providersHelp: Accounts own billing and shared quotas; each account can hold several plans and packages.
supply.advancedHelp: The previous execution workspace is retained for technical configuration. Inventory setup is handled in Resources.
supply.pool.help: Group packages by their intended use and set which supply should be used first. Execution comes next.
supply.pool.prerequisite: Configure a package before creating a pool.
supply.pool.name: Pool name
supply.pool.priorityHelp: The first package has the highest usage priority. Use the move controls to change the order.
supply.pool.noCompatible: No configured packages have this intended use. Add one in Resources.
supply.pool.invalid: Name the pool. Your selected packages and order are kept.
supply.pool.noMembers: This pool has no packages. Edit it to add a supply.
supply.pool.unavailable: Package is no longer available; review the saved inventory.
supply.sharedEditHelp: Changing this account limit affects every package on the account. It cannot be removed while other packages reference it.
supply.quantityError: Enter a positive number in full, for example 3000000 or 25.01.
supply.typeFixed: To change the resource type, unit or sharing scope, remove this resource and add another. Account-wide limits stay shared.
supply.readOnly: Read-only access. An administrator can configure these packages and pools.
